question: What is the position of non-metals in the periodic table?
solution:
The correct answer is __**On the right side**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Non-metals** in the periodic table are present in the **p block **which lies on **the right side of it**.
 
• The total number of non-metals in the periodic table is **18**.
 
• They are also found within groups 13-18, except hydro
